title: ICON 1.5 — House Rules
description: GM only. The optional rules of the system: where to turn them on and what they change at the table.

steps.title: House rules
steps.content:
ICON 1.5 follows the book (RAW) by default. A few optional rules can be turned on for your table: this tour shows where they are and what each one changes.
They are world settings, so only the GM can change them, and they apply to everyone.

steps.title: Where they live
steps.content: Game Settings → Configure Settings → ICON 1.5. The rules marked House Rule are off until you tick them; press Save Changes at the bottom to apply.

steps.title: Party Resolve +1 per round
steps.content: Not a house rule: this is the book (p.99), so it starts on. At the start of every round Party Resolve goes up by 1 and every PC sheet follows. Turn it off only if your table prefers to track Resolve by hand with the − / + in the combat tracker.

steps.title: Dust to heal Burdens
steps.content: During an Interlude each character unticks 3 Burden segments (p.42). With this rule on, the Interlude macro also asks how many extra segments to heal at 2 Dust each. The book is not consistent here: p.42 lists the 2-Dust trade only for Ambition clocks, the Dust list on p.242 names Burden clocks too. Turn it on if your table reads it the p.242 way.

steps.title: Heroic and Routine rolls
steps.content: The book has one result table for narrative rolls: 1-3 fail, 4-5 partial, 6 success. With this rule on, the narrative roll dialog gets a Roll Type menu: Heroic (harder): 1-4 fail, 5 partial, 6 success. Routine (easier): 1-2 fail, 3-4 partial, 5-6 success. The chat card shows which type was rolled.

steps.title: Changing your mind
steps.content:
You can switch these on and off at any time, even mid-campaign: nothing on the characters changes, only how the next roll or Interlude works.
Tell your players which ones you use — they don't see this page.
